summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments, then update project documentation (DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, filesystem spec) to reflect the current state of phases 28-37, and plan the next two phases.
summary.outcome: All 4 PR review threads resolved and merged to main. Documentation branch created with updated DEFERRED.md (pruned stale/implemented items), FEATURES.md (new features + E2E coverage), README.md, and a new FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md. Phases 38 (service retirement) and 39 (user-configurable vault params) added to roadmap.

repo: Grafana Faro is the error tracking and remote log shipping solution — Sentry was never adopted. Faro's beforeSend scrubbing + registerFaroTransport sends errors/warnings to Grafana Cloud.
Desktop FUSE components are intentionally not unit tested — they are OS integration plumbing tested via Desktop E2E suite instead.
Vault v1 legacy columns were removed when staging was reset; the full schema baseline (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) does not include them.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator env var, not a user-facing setting — user-configurable retention is still a deferred feature.
The @cipherbox/crypto devDependency on @cipherbox/core is test-only (vault-ipns.test.ts), meant to be cleaned up after Phase 19.1 restructuring but never was.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 functions actually used) are still active despite SDK equivalents existing.
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy-focused product.
Per-file IPNS conflict detection was implemented in Phase 12.6; pin:secondaryFailed event was implemented in Phase 37.
Linux FUSE mount and CTR streaming are implemented in crates/fuse/src/platform/linux.rs and crates/fuse/src/operations.rs respectively.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw synchronously, leaking pending entries — fixed with try/catch that cleans up pending map on error.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — corrected to clarify actual behavior.
Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — architectural limitation requiring SDK contract change (accept File objects or read callback instead of Uint8Array), tracked as deferred.
Only test file importing @cipherbox/core from @cipherbox/crypto package — the circular devDependency exists solely for this test and should be refactored to use hardcoded test vectors.

workflow: When asked to audit/prune a list, go through every single item systematically — do not stop after addressing items the user explicitly calls out.
Resolving GraphQL review threads can be batched in a single mutation call.
gh api REST comments require --field for integer params (in_reply_to) and --raw-field for string params.
useFileOperations.ts at 515 lines with 3 cohesive callbacks sharing state is considered reasonable — decomposition would add no value.
Live API integration tests failing in CI are pre-existing and unrelated to local changes — check before flagging as regressions.

friction: Initial DEFERRED.md audit was shallow — only verified items the user explicitly called out rather than every item, requiring multiple correction rounds.
Edit tool reformatted markdown table widths making subsequent edits require re-reading the file to get exact content.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS was initially misidentified as implementing the user-facing feature, when it is actually an operator env var — required a correction commit.
DTS circular dependency was initially removed from DEFERRED as 'by design' but was actually a cleanup oversight from Phase 19.1 — required re-adding.
The web worker encryption todo file was still in pending/ despite Phase 37 implementing it — required manual move to done/.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts and bin.service.ts by migrating remaining callers to SDK methods; also refactor vault-ipns.test.ts to remove @cipherbox/crypto circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core.
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period (default 30 days), soft vs hard delete behavior, versioning defaults (max versions per file, version cooldown).
Lazy file reading within concurrency pool (useDropUpload.ts:140) — requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array.
Batch upload not implemented in Rust SDK — feature matrix gap noted.
Cross-platform filesystem gaps documented in FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md — 5 documented gaps including case sensitivity differences between Windows/macOS/Linux.
